findings.title: Quote validated user and hostname values when emitting cloud-init YAML
findings.detail: Regex accepts valid names such as user true or hostname null. Interpolation writes name:true, hostname:null, unquoted flowsequence owner/group arguments and local-hostname:null. YAML consumers type these as boolean/null rather than requestednames.
